description:
Make sure the repository-state layer owns every finalization case the storage tests cover, before the storage re-proof goes.

## Background

`crates/jit/src/storage/repository_state_store_tests.rs:1754-2585` ("typed mutation determinism across both backends", about 830 lines) re-proves mutation finalization against both backends. Its own header states that the finalizer's serialized issue, gate, provenance and event bytes, and the identifiers and timestamps it assigns, are a pure function of the captured image and the injected mutation context. The finalizer and its unit tests are in `crates/jit/src/repository_state/mutation.rs`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each finalization property the section asserts has an owning unit test in `repository_state` that runs with no storage backend: serialized bytes, assigned identifiers and timestamps, and no-op operations that sample neither.
- [hard] REQ-02: A property already owned there is not duplicated.
title: Repository-state tests own each finalization case
